A daily cycling commute occurs five times weekly, alongside zero alcohol consumption and an IPSS score of 7. Past medical history includes a youthful appendectomy and an unremarkable gastroenterology surveillance colonoscopy. Recent fatherhood of a first grandchild has triggered mild sleep disturbances. Vital signs remain stable, and he explicitly denies unexplained weight loss or bone pain. Current smoking status registers at 16 pack-years.

DRE: Normal. The prostate presents as symmetrically enlarged, exhibiting smooth, firm consistency without palpable nodules or asymmetry. General assessment yields unremarkable results, with vital signs recording a blood pressure of 94/80 mmHg and a heart rate of 69 bpm. Palpation of the abdomen reveals a soft, non-tender region devoid of masses or organomegaly.
